summary:
PROPOSED, not yet accepted (FS.GG.Game#789, Outcome .github#5218). The ADR is docs/roadmaps/game-render-02-glyphs.md; it is canonical, and this record indexes it.

**Observed on 2026-11-01:**
- RuneScape, BAR, FourD, SC2 and the template each build their own symbology from opaque `Rectangle`, `Circle` and `FilledEllipse` nodes inside `Group`. That set is the canvas ceiling: `SceneShapes.fs` skips every other node.
- Strokes are faked by layering (rings, four-band outlines, bar crosshairs).
- Helpers and palettes are duplicated: five colour constructors, and a selection colour of 255,140,0 in three games.
- The Fable view of FS.GG.UI.Scene (Rendering `src/Scene/Fable/FS.GG.UI.Scene.fsproj` at 2d35dc9b) does not compile `Scene.fs`. `Colors`, `Paint`, `Path` and the `Scene` constructors are therefore missing under Fable, and the profile grades them DotNetOnly.
- `ScenePixels` treats any unmodelled node (text, path, image) as Partial for every pixel. One such node makes `expectations` empty for the whole scene; a .NET test pins this.

**Proposed decisions:**
- **Glyph model.** A glyph says what it means and where it is. `draw : Theme -> Glyph -> GlyphDrawing` returns the nodes and the hit bounds together.
- **Lowering profiles.** Portable (fills only) is the default now; Stroked follows #773 and the new kit models. One profile applies to all backends, so they draw identical pixels.
- **Starter set:** unit, structure, terrain, item, marker, selection brackets, focus outline, hover, path, status and team colour.
- **Theme tokens:** palette, allegiance, stroke, gap and sizes. `Theme.validate` enforces a 3:1 non-text contrast floor against the ground and opaque colours only.
- **Themes:** standard, light, colour-blind-safe and high-contrast. In the colour-blind-safe theme, Okabe-Ito blue is 2.86:1 on the dark ground, so team 0 uses sky blue.
- **CSS and hex export** of the tokens, for parts of a game drawn outside the Scene.
- **Sprite atlases:** a manifest with a mandatory vector fallback per frame. Restricted images stay in gitignored fetch areas, following RuneScape's no-assets rule and the custody of Rendering#1495. CI and the kit probe the fallback.
- **Identical colour** depends on #786 (unlit Babylon).
- **ScenePixels** gains ring, band and polygon models, and bounded unmodelled nodes.
- **The Fable gap is fixed in FS.GG.Rendering.** Game publishes no rival `Scene` API. The Rendering Delivery is owed intake.
- **#790:** the Stroked node set is the SVG-import target vocabulary.
- **Migration:** the template first, then RuneScape.
- **Focus and selection** are drawn from state the game supplies. This is to be reconciled with #787.

**Proof** (experimental `FS.GG.Game.Reference.Experimental.Glyphs`, not packed): six glyphs in two themes on SVG, Pixi and Babylon.
- The browser smoke passed 490 checks with SwiftShader and with the fdev GPU (ANGLE Vulkan, RADV).
- On each backend all 391 decided pixels matched, and a theme-swap control did not.
- Babylon shows 0.75 of the colours until #786.

**Lesson:** use Floor, not Round, for glyph geometry, because .NET and Fable could break half-way ties differently.

**Not established:** acceptance, the implementation, consumer adoption and publication.
title: GAME-RENDER-02.4 shared glyph and symbology layer with theme tokens (proposed ADR and three-backend proof)
